title: Ground-Based Defense: War Room
summary: Two tracks. One interceptor. Take command in Night Watch, work the GBI fire controls, or tell a hospital whether it’s safe to move patients in After the Flash.
summaryZhTW: 兩道航跡，一枚攔截彈。你可以在《Night Watch》接掌指揮席、操作 GBI 火控台，或在《閃光之後》判讀觀測報告，告訴醫院能否轉送病患。
coverAlt: A watch commander faces two amber tracks on a map of the North Pacific beneath the War Room title.
limitations: GBI Fire Control is in English. Night Watch and After the Flash also support Traditional Chinese.

approval.note: Creator authorized publication of the three-module release to Possibility Games.
